description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Illinois Compiled Statutes — Illinois state law — by citation. "720 ILCS 5/9-1" is first degree murder; "625 ILCS 5/11-501" is DUI. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does 720 ILCS 5/9-1 say" or to check an Illinois statute a case relies on.

act.description: Act number within the chapter — the part after ILCS and before the slash, e.g. "5".

name: il_compiled_statute
title: Il Compiled Statute
